gen-dafont-neon-fs-gambetta: Neon draws every letter with a single unbroken line width and stands tall like stamped metal, glowing from end to end. Gambetta, a classic serif, swells and softens where it curves.
gen-dafont-neon-lora: Glowing and tall, Neon holds one level line through every letter with no weight accents. Lora, a classic serif, adds gentle modulation, so give it a comfortable size and let the paragraphs breathe.
gen-dafont-neon-noto-serif: Glowing stamped-metal capitals, with the steady line of a drafting pen. Noto Serif takes the opposite route, a prominent x-height and a subtle thick and thin cadence that rewards a closer look.
gen-dafont-neuropol-crimson-pro: Futuristic and digital, Neuropol keeps its letters nearly closed, a single-weight outline with only a slim channel for the c. Crimson Pro, a refined serif, opens its shapes wide and lets a gentle thick and thin cadence run across the page.
gen-dafont-neuropol-fs-bespoke-slab: Neuropol is digital and futuristic, with slim openings in its single-weight outlines. Bespoke Slab, a grounded serif with tall lowercase bodies, gives those moderate-height headings a sturdier, more refined partner underneath.
gen-dafont-neuropol-newsreader: Sleek and futuristic, Neuropol rounds its letters with walls as heavy as its straight strokes, nearly closing them. Newsreader, a classic serif, opens every curve with a mild, friendly contrast and reads with quiet authority.
gen-dafont-neuropol-source-serif-4: Dignified and professional, this body text opens its curves with a gaping c and a slight tightening at the tops. Source Serif 4 has moderate contrast, so a long stretch of it feels steady beneath Neuropol's closed, tubing-bent headings.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-gambetta: Neuropolitical looks pulled apart letter by letter, with big open counters glowing like neon tube at one steady thickness. Gambetta, a serif, has bookish contrast that is tempered, so size it generously.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-lora: Neuropolitical's wirelike strokes never change thickness, like neon tube. Lora, a classic serif with hairlines that are present but not razor thin and a broad c, rewards a body size that lets those curves show.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-noto-serif: Neuropolitical looks drawn with one pen tip, its letters pulled apart and glowing at a single line thickness. And Noto Serif, a text serif with a prominent x-height, answers with modest contrast that you notice only up close.
